student_learning_goal: I can test and refine my steps.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can test and refine my steps.
header.character_watermark: Bot and Buggy the Beetle in the top-right with a magnifying glass. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: For 3 codes, circle BUG or NO BUG.
parts.visual_layout: Three small grids each with a code strip and BUG / NO BUG circles.

image_placeholders.description: A Kindergarten bug-test layout for coding worksheet, B&W line art. 3 small grids each with: Bot, target, and a code strip. Below each: BUG / NO BUG circles.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS04_P1_TEST at Part 1: keywords name the codes test for bug task.

parts.answer_key: Depends on each code; mix of bug and no bug.

parts.student_instructions: One code has a BUG. Cross out the wrong arrow and write the correct one.
parts.visual_layout: A buggy code strip with a target grid and replacement arrow box.

image_placeholders.description: A Kindergarten bug-fix layout for coding worksheet, B&W line art. A buggy code: → → ↓ ↑. Beside: grid with Bot at A1 and target at B3. Below: replacement arrow box.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS04_P2_FIX at Part 2: keywords name the fix wrong arrow task.

parts.student_instructions: Write a 4-step code that reaches the apple. Make sure NO BUG!
parts.visual_layout: Empty 4-box code strip beside a grid with Bot and apple.

image_placeholders.description: A Kindergarten code-writing workspace for coding worksheet, B&W line art. Empty 4-box code strip. Beside: 4x4 grid with Bot at A1 and apple at C3.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS04_P3_WRITE at Part 3: keywords name the code apple workspace task.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, design a buggy code for a friend.
teacher_notes: Lesson 4 consolidation. Formative — check bug detection.
